newsitem.title: GERMANY: SPD's Matthaeus-Maier says tax deal possible.
newsitem.headline: SPD's Matthaeus-Maier says tax deal possible.

text.p: Ingrid Matthaeus-Maier, financial spokeswoman for the opposition Social Democrats (SPD), said on Friday a tax reform compromise with Chancellor Helmut Kohl's Christian Democrats (CDU) is possible.
But in a radio interview she warned Finance Minister Theo Waigel that if he sticks to his proposal it will not pass the upper house of parliament, where the SPD holds the majority.
Matthaeus-Maier said she believes the two sides will reach an agreement that will cut non-wage labour costs and the lowest rate of income tax.
The SPD is prepared to make such a deal, but the government must stop harping on cutting the top tax rate, she said.
Waigel is due to present at 1100 GMT his legislative proposals for the tax reform, aimed at stimulating growth and creating jobs.
